scenes.tagline: The risk checker now runs in an Intel TDX enclave.
scenes.tag: Recorded live · Phala Cloud · NEAR testnet · Nov 7, 2026
scenes.vo: Chaperone's risk checker now runs inside an Intel TDX enclave, and the NEAR vault checks the proof itself. Recorded live.

scenes.head: The checker image, pinned by digest
scenes.sub: Built from the public repo by CI, deployed to a Phala Cloud confidential VM.
scenes.vo: The checker image is built from the public repo and pinned by its digest. We deploy it to a confidential VM on Phala Cloud.

scenes.head: Running inside the enclave
scenes.sub: At boot it makes its signing key in enclave memory. Nothing outside ever sees it.
scenes.vo: It boots in seconds and makes its signing key inside the enclave. Nothing outside ever sees it.

scenes.head: An Intel-signed quote binds this vault and this key
scenes.sub: Checked with the same Rust code the contract runs: DCAP chain, RTMR3 replay, compose hash.
scenes.vo: Its attestation is an Intel-signed quote that binds this vault and this key. We check it with the same Rust code the contract runs.

scenes.head: The vault verifies the quote on chain
scenes.sub: The owner approves the image. register_checker checks 59 KB of attestation for 188 Tgas.
scenes.vo: The owner approves that image. Then the vault verifies the quote itself, on chain, and only then trusts the key.

scenes.head: Live on the dashboard
scenes.sub: Read from the contract: Intel TDX enclave, verified on chain, TCB up to date.
scenes.vo: The dashboard reads it straight from the contract.

scenes.head: Every verdict now comes from the enclave
scenes.sub: The real invoice is paid. 500 USDC to a flagged scammer is blocked. A self-signed verdict is refused.
scenes.vo: Now every verdict comes from the enclave. The real invoice gets paid. Five hundred USDC to a flagged scammer is blocked. And a verdict the agent signs for itself is refused.

scenes.head: Every decision, on the record
scenes.sub: The vault's own log on NEAR testnet, read by the dashboard.
scenes.vo: And every decision lands in the vault's log, on chain.

lines: The checker proves where it runs.
scenes.footer: Recorded live on Phala Cloud and NEAR testnet, Nov 7 2026
scenes.vo: Chaperone. The agent can only ask, the rules decide, and now the checker proves where it runs.
